# Warm paper, not a dark cockpit

> A dark cockpit borrows its authority from instrument panels, and this is a place you read prose an agent wrote and decide whether you agree.

Applies to `web/src/**`.

<!-- archwarden:yours -->

## Context

_Everything between these two markers is yours. archwarden never rewrites it._

<!-- archwarden:end -->

## Considered and rejected

- **The dark instrument-panel palette** (nothing refuses it) — Its principle held — colour is reserved for things that ask for an action — and its ground did not. Eight hours of reading on black feels like surveillance rather than work.
- **Web fonts** (nothing refuses it) — The app must open with no network at all, and a font that arrives late is a layout that moves under the reader.
- **Monaco's stock themes** (nothing refuses it) — Cold. A panel that does not belong to the page around it reads as a different program embedded in this one.

## What keeps it

Nothing can. The rule worth having — no colour literal outside `theme.css` — is neither a rendered element nor a callee, so no chokepoint reaches it. Filed upstream as archwarden#177.
